dict.Verifică dacă PDF-ul e gata de tipar sau: Check whether the PDF is ready to print or publish: fonts, picture resolution, colours, transparency, thin lines, trim box and bleed, for the chosen profile (print shop, office, web)
dict.Da: prima pagină se arată înainte să se: Yes: the first page shows before the whole file is downloaded.
dict.Fiecare cere o placă de tipar separată;: Each needs a separate printing plate; check with the print shop that you want them this way.
dict.Fișier mic: pozele de peste 225 ppi sunt: Small file: pictures above 225 ppi are flagged as too large; fonts embedded, no open passwords.
dict.Fișierul e criptat (parolă sau restricți: The file is encrypted (password or restrictions).
dict.Fișierul e criptat; tipografiile îl cer: The file is encrypted; print shops need it without a password and without restrictions.
The file is ready for the chosen profile.
dict.Fișierul nu declară un profil de tipar P: The file does not declare a PDF/X print profile; many print shops also accept ordinary PDFs.
dict.La imprimanta obișnuită se tipăresc ca a: On an ordinary printer they print as a mix of colours.
There are no pictures on the pages.
dict.Nu: browserul descarcă tot fișierul înai: No: the browser downloads the whole file before the first page.
dict.Pentru tipar e mai sigur să aplatizezi f: For printing it is safer to flatten the form.
dict.Pozele de cel puțin 150 ppi, fonturile î: Pictures of at least 150 ppi, embedded fonts, comments that do not print.
dict.Pozele de cel puțin 300 ppi, fonturile î: Pictures of at least 300 ppi, embedded fonts, trim box and bleed, no lines that are too thin; RGB and transparency are flagged.
All fonts are in the file.
All lines are at least 0.25 pt.
dict.Unele tipografii (fluxurile PDF/X-1a) ce: Some print shops (PDF/X-1a workflows) need transparency flattened; ask them.
dict.Du-te la prima pagină cu această problem: Go to the first page with this problem
